approved: Freeze on Rent and Rate Increases Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would create a national pause on rent and interest rate rises.
The Commonwealth would work with state governments to stop rent increases for two years, then limit them after that, and end evictions without a stated reason.
The bill's sponsor says rents are rising at the fastest rate ever recorded and that renters are paying an extra $10 billion a year in rent.
Stops rent increases nationwide for two years.
Caps rent increases after the two-year freeze ends.
Renters, landlords, and state governments are affected.
